messages:
rachel-csm: Quick heads-up  Arxly onboarding traffic spiked beyond forecast. Need a 15m triage to lock a short-term cost gate and a clean QBR slide. :wave:
tomo-finops: Pulled the billing export. Baseline ~3k tokens/day -> 88k in the last 24h for the onboarding cohort. If sustained, rough add'l monthly ~$11k. Renewal-risk leaning medium-high. Recommend provisional credit cap + invoice-alerting. :rotating_light:
vince-ops: Two fast levers: tenant daily credit cap (can be set today) and enable adaptive batching on the batch-embed endpoint (short rollout). Credit cap gives immediate protection.
meera-qa: If we flip a cap, need the client-visible contract so I can write regressions. Should be graceful: warn headers, then 429 with details.
rachel-csm: Proposed immediate config: daily_credits=100000; alerts at [40,75,95] pct; soft_warn_at=85% (email + in-app banner) ; hard_block_at=120% -> invoice hold. Sales override token allowed for demos. I'll draft the QBR slide and customer note.
tomo-finops: Draft rule (engineer snippet) below  confirmable?
```
policy:
  tenant: arxly
  daily_credits: 100000
  thresholds_pct: [40,75,95]
  soft_warn_pct: 85
  hard_block_pct: 120
  notify: ["rachel-csm","tomo-finops"]
  escalate: "invoice-hold if >120% for 1 billing cycle"
```
billingbot: Policy created: arxly-onboard-guard-3723456789. Webhooks wired to #customer-success and ops-oncall.
arxly-pm: Appreciate the quick loop. Please avoid hard blocks during live demos; prefer throttles + clear X-Quota-Remaining header so our infra can adapt. We'll send top-12 prompts and expected concurrency today.
vince-ops: We will return 429 with body {"code":"quota_exceeded","allowed_remaining":0} and header X-Quota-Remaining. Also will emit webhook events when thresholds cross. Batching toggle can be enabled for their tenant tomorrow.
meera-qa: Got the contract, I'll add test vectors for realtime and batch paths and include a consumer-facing one-pager.
rachel-csm: I'll add a conservative/likely/upside spend table to the QBR doc (https://redwood.internal/qbrs/arxly-qbr) and mark renewal risk as "monitoring - medium-high" pending customer responses. Aim to close triage by EOD so slide is finalized. :thumbsup:
